_about: Tapestries, sold at the TIE-DYE & TAPESTRY stall on Shakedown Street and hung on the line at your camp. You can own several and hang one at a time. The one that is up lifts your Vibes a little while you are at camp. 'draw' names the pattern main.js paints (leopard, tiger, zebra, patchwork, sunmoon, tree, wavy); 'colors' are that pattern's colours, background first.

canopy._about: Pop-up canopies from the General Store. You stand each one anywhere on your plot (tent menu, Rearrange your camp). One keeps you dry at camp in rain; each can carry one tapestry on its back wall, and every tapestry hanging at camp gives vibesPerHour.
